name: troll-combat
description: M4 S6 scenario, fight the troll with the elvish sword. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000 = 1977-12-12 12:00:00 UTC, zone UTC, microseconds 0, as house-boot). The sword-glow path (tests/scenarios/sword-glow.json) into the troll room, then `kill troll with sword` three times: KILLER (77act1.mud:1699) -> BLOW (78melee.mud:377) for the hero, the troll's counterattack through the demon FIGHTING (78melee.mud:282) -> BLOW, the troll's action TROLL (77act1.mud:360), and PRES (78melee.mud:351) choosing each remark with RANDOM. Under the fixed clock and seed the fight is deterministic: the first attack only pinks the troll (light wound, MAX at 78melee.mud:447) and the troll misses; the second knocks the axe to the floor and the troll recovers it; the third kills the troll (black fog, the carcass disappears, the sword stops glowing). Then `diagnose`, `score`, `inventory`, `look`, `take axe` (the axe vanished with the troll) and `east` out of the troll room. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/TROLL-COMBAT-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `east` (D3 end-of-input applies).
